components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Crisp paper-filled action used over photography; night mode swaps to cyan through the live theme tokens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--ivory); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ivory); color: var(--ink); font: 12px/1.65 var(--font-sans); transition: transform 250ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cedar); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A low-contrast bordered action that keeps photography visible.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 238, 228, .48); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(32, 35, 31, .12); color: var(--ivory); font: 12px/1.65 var(--font-sans); transition: transform 250ms ease, background 250ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(243, 238, 228, .18); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cedar); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Indexed Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet sans-serif navigation paired with a small mono index and thin active rule.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 10px 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font: 12px/1.55 var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav-link > span { color: var(--cedar); font: 8px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-nav-link strong { font-weight: 400; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--cedar); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 300ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after, .ds-nav-link.ds-is-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cedar); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A compact bordered mode control with a circular icon well and explicit text state.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { min-height: 38px; padding: 4px 9px 4px 5px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(32, 35, 31, .2); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(243, 238, 228, .3); color: var(--ink); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 220ms ease, background 220ms ease; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--cedar); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cedar); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-theme-icon { width: 27px; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(32, 35, 31, .2); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-theme-copy { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 6px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-theme-copy small { color: var(--muted); font: 7px/1.4 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-theme-copy strong { color: var(--cedar); font: 11px/1 var(--font-serif); }

components.css: .ds-cabin { min-height: 520px; padding: 36px; position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: #d8d1c4; color: #272923; } .ds-cabin-skip { position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 28px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 0 5px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; color: #373b35; font: 500 10px/1.4 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .11em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cabin-skip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9a4f3f; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-cabin-copy { position: absolute; left: 5%; max-width: 11ch; margin: 0; font: 400 34px/.94 var(--font-serif); letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-window-frame { width: 245px; aspect-ratio: .72; padding: 24px; border-radius: 42%/24%; background: #eee9de; box-shadow: inset 0 -20px 38px rgba(89, 82, 71, .16), 0 24px 70px rgba(54, 49, 43, .2); } .ds-window-view { height: 100%; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 41%/23%; background: #242a24; box-shadow: inset 0 18px 34px rgba(25, 27, 23, .38); } .ds-window-shade { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 9%; border-radius: 36% 36% 9% 9%/17% 17% 4% 4%; background: #e4ded2; box-shadow: 0 14px 20px rgba(38, 36, 31, .28); } .ds-window-shade i { width: 34%; height: 8px; position: absolute; left: 33%; bottom: -4px; border-radius: 999px; background: #bdb6aa; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio should feel collected rather than manufactured: real photographs, oversized editorial type, precise index labels, and the warm restraint of a well-kept travel journal. Expressive moments frame Jaden's work and travel records, but the content remains legible, honest, and recognizably present beneath them.

Day mode uses paper, wood, earth, and natural-light associations. Night mode is a distinct city-after-dark treatment with monospaced display type, deep surfaces, and sparing cyan and magenta signals; it is not a literal color inversion. Physical interactions may become immersive, as in the travel entrance, when material, lighting, geometry, and motion all serve a clear passage into real content.
keyCharacteristics: Real photography leads; graphic treatment supports it.
Editorial scale is paired with small, exact monospaced metadata.
Day feels warm and tactile; night feels urban, electric, and controlled.
Motion reveals hierarchy or models a physical action, then gets out of the way.
Expressive entrances preserve an immediate, accessible route to the content.

rules.name: The Photograph Leads Rule
rules.body: Use real project and travel imagery as the visual evidence; color fields and generated geometry may frame it but cannot impersonate it.

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Day and night are authored presentations with their own imagery and typographic character, not automated palette inversions.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Cedar, cyan, and magenta mark hierarchy or state; they do not become broad decorative washes.

rules.name: The Scale-and-Precision Rule
rules.body: Pair one commanding editorial statement with restrained body copy and exact monospaced metadata; do not make every layer loud.

rules.name: The Honest Depth Rule
rules.body: Add elevation only when it explains layering, control state, or physical construction.

dos: **Do** keep real photography visible as evidence and continuity across transitions.
**Do** preserve a clear typographic hierarchy: editorial display, readable sans-serif body, and precise mono metadata.
**Do** author day and night as related but distinct photographic worlds.
**Do** use physical geometry, lighting, and motion together when an interaction represents a real object.
**Do** provide keyboard, touch, reduced-motion, non-WebGL, and skip paths for immersive experiences.
**Do** test full-viewport objects at mobile widths and dynamic viewport heights.
donts: **Don't** replace useful content with spectacle; the destination page remains the payoff.
**Don't** use abstract decoration when a real photograph or legible structural element carries the story better.
**Don't** default to rounded cards, glassmorphism, broad neon washes, or synthetic depth.
**Don't** present placeholder travel chapters as completed journeys.
**Don't** allow motion, media, or optional rendering capability to become the only path forward.
